content: Chatbot-to-human handoff best practice bundle: full transcript + 2-3 sentence AI summary + detected intent/category + sentiment/frustration level + 'what was tried, what remains'. 85% of chatbot handoffs are reported to lose context when done poorly. Warm transfer (briefed receiving party before connecting) vs cold transfer (dumped with only notes) - warm strongly preferred for anything emotional/complex. Triggers: explicit user request (always honor immediately), repeated bot failure, negative sentiment, keyword/high-stakes triggers.
